sql: with f as ( select o.market_ticker t, o.side oside, o.action oact, coalesce((f.raw_fill_json->>'count_fp')::numeric, f.quantity::numeric) q, case when f.side = o.side then f.price else 100 - f.price end px, coalesce(f.fee,0) fee from fills f join live_orders o on o.kalshi_order_id = f.kalshi_order_id where o.strategy = 'Kmmsell10' and o.created_at >= '2026-10-11' ), s as ( select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker t, coalesce(quantity_fp, quantity) qty, coalesce((raw_json->>'value')::numeric, case lower(raw_json->>'market_result') when 'yes' then 100 when 'no' then 0 end) yv from positions where market_ticker in (select t from f) order by market_ticker, captured_at desc, id desc ), m as ( select f.t, sum(case when f.oact='buy' then f.q else 0 end) contracts, sum((case when f.oact='buy' then 1 else -1 end) * f.q * ((case when f.oside='no' then 100 - s.yv else s.yv end) - f.px)) / 100 - sum(f.fee) pnl from f join s on s.t = f.t where abs(coalesce(s.qty,0)) < 0.01 and s.yv is not null group by f.t ) select count(*) settled_markets, round(sum(contracts),2) settled_contracts, round(sum(pnl),2) realized_usd, round(min(pnl),2) worst_market_usd, (select t from m order by pnl asc limit 1) worst_ticker, sum(case when pnl < 0 then 1 else 0 end) losing_markets, round(100.0 * sum(pnl) / nullif(sum(contracts),0), 2) cents_per_contract from m
